## sequential palette testing


```{r, echo = T, results = 'hide', message=FALSE, warning = FALSE}

req <- c("ggplot2", "DBI", "dplyr")
to_install <- req[!(req %in% installed.packages()[,"Package"])]
if(length(to_install)) install.packages(to_install)

library(DBI)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)


# NEED TO HAVE OPENED RPROJ FILE TO BE ON THE CORRECT PATH FOR BELOW TO RUN
devtools::load_all()

conn <- DBI::dbConnect(RPostgres::Postgres())

## ONS UK Total Trade
ons_trade <- dbGetQuery(conn,'SELECT * FROM ons.trade__uk_totals_sa;')

ons_exports <- ons_trade %>%
  filter(period_type == 'year' & product_name == 'goods') %>%
  filter(period >=2010) %>%
  filter(ons_region_name %in% c('Bangladesh', 'Japan', 'Switzerland', 'Brazil','Australia','Mexico','India')) %>%
  filter(direction == 'exports') %>%
  select(ons_region_name, period, value)

data_wide <- ons_exports %>% 
  spread(key = period, value = value) %>%
  gather(key = "period", value = "value", - ons_region_name)
```

## Heatmap - sequential blues (default)

```{r, echo=FALSE}
seq_blues <- dbt_palettes$sequential$default

ggplot(data_wide, aes(x = as.factor(period), y = ons_region_name, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() + 
  theme_dbt() +
  labs(title = "UK exports to countries") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = seq_blues)

```

## Heatmap - sequential berry

```{r, echo=FALSE}
seq_berry <- dbt_palettes$sequential$berry

ggplot(data_wide, aes(x = as.factor(period), y = ons_region_name, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() + 
  theme_dbt() +
  labs(title = "UK exports to countries") +
  scale_fill_gradientn(colours = seq_berry)

```
